services.name: Sandbar Swim
services.desc: Explore Crystal Blue Waters >A trip to the sandbar makes for the perfect alternative to snorkeling when the weather doesn't cooperate. This 2.5 hour trip visits White Marlin sandbar located on the bayside. We have pool noodles and life jackets to keep the fun going for all ages. For adults (21+) we also have a full bar on board offering mixed drinks, beer, wine and seltzers for purchase. --- Duration >2.5 hours --- Available Times >Daily at Bayside Sandbar Trip · 3 hours

services.name: Snorkel the Reef
services.desc: Explore below Crystal Blue Waters >Enjoy the 2.5 hour excursion aboard our 65 foot power catamaran, Blue. We provide fun noodles, life jackets, and snorkel gear. Bring towels and sunscreen and we will provide the rest. --- Duration >2.5 hours --- Available Times >Daily at 9:00am (seasonally) and 1:00pm Most Popular! · 2.5 hours · Gear Available

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Join us for Sunset >Savor a picturesque sunset aboard Blue, our 65 foot catamaran. All ages are welcome. Complimentary beer, wine, and a champagne toast are provided. --- Duration >1.5-2 hours --- Available Times >Seasonal based on time of 1.5 - 2 Hours · Complimentary Champagne Toast!

services.name: SNUBA
services.desc: Dive Experience life beneath the sea with a guided SNUBA dive. Yep, we spelled that right! No certifications are necessary for this type of diving. After a brief safety and equipment lesson, you’ll be ready to explore our underwater world! You can dive up to 20 feet beneath the surface and come face to face with sea turtles, puffers, rays and a large assortment of other fish and marine life. It’s like swimming in an oversized aquarium, only better! Ages 8+ and up and the ability to swim is required. Some medical restrictions apply. If you have any questions about your medical ability Ages 8+ · 2.5 hours

blurb: Sundance Watersports offers snorkeling tours, sandbar swims, SNUBA diving, sunset cruises, and private charters in Islamorada. They operate a catamaran named Blue for corporate and private events. The business is locally owned and operated since 1994.
